info.title: Stroke Server API v1

get.description:
Every implementation allowed by a loaded pipeline, with its deployment setting.
An implementation without a setting row is disabled.

schema.title: Response List Implementations Api V1 Admin Implementations Get

put.description:
Enable or disable an implementation and optionally make it the slot's default.
Making one the default clears the default of the slot's other implementations.

schema.title: Response List Cases Api V1 Cases Get

delete.description:
Soft-delete the case and remove its files. Refused while a run is active or when
the case is flagged keep-forever.

patch.description:
Edit ``sex`` and ``age_band`` (null clears); ``keep_forever`` is for administrators.
Existing runs keep the values frozen at their creation.

schema.title: Response List Inputs Api V1 Cases  Case Id  Inputs Get

put.description:
Upload or replace the input of one role (for example ``ct``, ``lesion_native``,
``lesion_mni``), before the first run. 201 for a new role, 200 for a replacement.

schema.title: Response List Case Runs Api V1 Cases  Case Id  Runs Get

post.description:
Resolve the pipeline against the case's inputs, validate the per-slot choices
(422 when a choice is not enabled), store the run as ``queued`` and enqueue it.

schema.title: Response List Pipelines Api V1 Pipelines Get

get.description: Slots of a pipeline with their enabled implementations and the default of each.

schema.title: Response List Slots Api V1 Pipelines  Pipeline Id  Versions  Version  Slots Get

get.description:
Status, slot choices (implementation, image digest, parameters, bundles) and the
step timeline (one entry per attempt).

schema.title: Response List Artifacts Api V1 Runs  Run Id  Artifacts Get

post.description:
Idempotent (docs/data-model.md 7.3): 200 when the run is canceled, 202 while a
running run is asked to stop, 409 ``run_not_active`` for a finished run.

schema.title: Response List Reports Api V1 Runs  Run Id  Reports Get

post.description:
Resume a failed or canceled run from its failed step: succeeded slots are kept,
the seed, choices, parameters and bundles stay those of the run. 202 when queued,
200 when the run is already active; refusals are 409 with the codes of data-model.md 7.3.
Alias of ``resume`` ("retry from the failed step" is the same operation).

schema.title: Response List Steps Api V1 Runs  Run Id  Steps Get

get.description:
The last ``tail_bytes`` of the attempt's log. ``X-Log-Truncated: true`` when the
start is missing (cut here or by the orchestrator).
